adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review repaired the worker-2 zero-row activity gap, replaced placeholder database conflict statuses with row-level source verification, and limited mechanism claims to direct, locator-backed evidence. The paper is accepted with explicit cautions because exact figure-only bar values and a separate linked sequence database snapshot are unavailable locally, but all gate-relevant local material has been exhausted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figure panels were inspected, but only values/concentrations stated in primary text, captions, or linked database rows were promoted as exact rows.
The article has zero XML table-wrap elements; row-level activity/toxicity evidence is source-reviewed from prose, captions, figure images, methods, and database rows.
Database peptide identity is verified from Figure 1A/prose and linked assay/literature rows; the packet has no separate linked_sequence_records row.
OA package Data_Sheet_1.docx contains supplementary structure surface and qPCR primer information; local landing-*.bin files are HTML pages and do not add activity/toxicity tables.

details.merged_database_rows: All linked DBAASP assay, experiment, and literature JSONL rows were reconciled.
details.oa_package: Tar archive member list reviewed; Figure 1-3 images and Data_Sheet_1.docx inspected where relevant.
details.paper_xml_pdf: Primary XML and pdftotext output reviewed for methods/results/captions and exact prose-supported values.
details.supplementary_assets: Local landing-*.bin files are HTML pages; OA package Data_Sheet_1.docx contains Supplementary Figure S1 and qPCR primer table, not activity/toxicity tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows are source-reviewed. Prior source_conflict/database-only placeholders were resolved by mapping MIC, MBIC, MBEC90, hemolysis, and HEK293 rows to primary prose/figures while preserving cautions about endpoint labels and absent linked sequence snapshot.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Five PEW300 activity/toxicity rows were recovered from primary Results, methods, figure captions/images, and linked database rows; no unsupported figure-only exact values were fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are now source-located and limited to direct assays reported in Figures 6-9 and Methods; claims remain cautious where exact graph values are not text-supported.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: Data_Sheet_1.docx and local HTML landing files were checked; they do not supply additional activity/toxicity values that would change the gate.
